aesthetic_description: Dark fantasy ARPG UI inspired by Diablo IV, Path of Exile, and Hades. Gritty, arcane, heavy textures (stone, leather, parchment), high contrast glows, ornate framing, deep layers.

headings.style: Ornate, sharp, majestic. Use tight tracking. Often uppercase for major titles.

body.style: Readable but thematic. Classic fantasy serif. Good for lore and standard descriptions.

stats_and_mono.style: Use for raw stats, damage numbers, cooldowns, and admin dashboard data.

verdant_wilds.atmosphere: Deep forest greens, glowing moss, wood brown, soft volumetric light.

ashen_wastes.atmosphere: Charcoal, smoldering orange embers, pale ash grey.

frozen_spire.atmosphere: Ice blue, stark white glares, deep navy abyss.

sunken_crypts.atmosphere: Seaweed green, abyssal black, bioluminescent cyan.

sky_citadel.atmosphere: Radiant white marble, golden clouds, storm gray shadows.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Dense and heavy. Information must be extremely clear in combat but panels should feel tangible.

hud_layout.bottom_center: Health and Mana Orbs flanking the hotbar (abilities/cooldowns).

panels.inventory: Diablo-style grid (e.g. 10x4 slots). Items take up varied slot sizes.
panels.skill_tree: Path of Exile style web. Full viewport overlay, panning and zooming enabled.

buttons.primary: Dark stone background, gold border, hover triggers a sigil inner-glow and border brightness increase. Text uses Cinzel.
buttons.danger: Dark stone background, crimson border, hover triggers blood-red inner glow.

panels.base_style: Deep background (#101014) with a slight noise texture. Border is thick and ornate, often using border-image with a metallic or carved stone look.
panels.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-md with bg-black/60 for overlay panels to obscure gameplay without blacking it out entirely.

tooltips.item_tooltip: Solid dark background (no blur) to ensure readability. Rarity color top border. Title is rarity colored. Line separators are subtle gradients (center to transparent). Stats in EB Garamond or Mono.

modals.style: Centered overlay, heavy #101014 background, thick gold or stone borders. Dim the backdrop heavily (bg-black/80).

tabs.style: Underline style or stone-carved blocks. Active tab has glowing text (Cinzel) and a gold bottom border. Inactive tabs are muted grey.

sliders.style: Track is dark groove (#050505 with inset shadow). Thumb is a glowing gem or metallic notch (Gold or Crimson).

inputs_and_admin.style: Shadcn based, but heavily customized. Borders are #3A3632, backgrounds are #050505. Focus states ring with gold (#A5854C) instead of standard blue.

button_hover.effect: Box-shadow inner glow pulses, border-color shifts to brighter gold.

item_drop.effect: Pop up from center, slight arc, settle down. Rarity-colored beam of light shoots up.

damage_numbers.effect: Translate Y upward by 40px, scale up then scale down, fade to opacity 0.

screen_shake.keyframes: 0% { transform: translate(1px, 1px) rotate(0deg); } 10% { transform: translate(-1px, -2px) rotate(-1deg); } 20% { transform: translate(-3px, 0px) rotate(1deg); } 30% { transform: translate(3px, 2px) rotate(0deg); } 40% { transform: translate(1px, -1px) rotate(1deg); } 50% { transform: translate(-1px, 2px) rotate(-1deg); } 60% { transform: translate(-3px, 1px) rotate(0deg); } 70% { transform: translate(3px, 1px) rotate(-1deg); } 80% { transform: translate(-1px, -1px) rotate(1deg); } 90% { transform: translate(1px, 2px) rotate(0deg); } 100% { transform: translate(1px, -2px) rotate(-1deg); }

tooltip_slide.effect: Fade in and slide up 10px fast (0.15s) ease-out.

textures.description: Dark grunge texture, use for panel backgrounds overlay with opacity 0.1
Dark marble/stone texture, use for heavy borders or primary action buttons

recommendations: Search for 'gothic gold frame png' for tooltip borders
Search for 'diablo 4 health orb transparent' as reference for CSS radial gradients
Search for 'seamless noise texture' to add film grain over the entire canvas

instructions_to_main_agent: Inject the Google Fonts directly into the main index.css or index.html.
Do NOT use typical SaaS layout components (like standard Shadcn Cards) without heavy customization. The game UI must feel physical, using heavy borders and textures.
For the Canvas viewport, use standard HTML5 canvas but overlay it with a full-screen CSS radial-gradient vignette to fake lighting depth.
Implement the Rarity colors as a universal map or CSS variables so they can be applied to text, borders, and box-shadow glows easily.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
For floating damage numbers, use absolutely positioned React portals or native canvas drawing, ensuring high performance.
The admin dashboard should still utilize the dark background and fonts but can use standard Shadcn tables/forms tweaked to have stone/gold borders.
Consider adding a custom cursor, e.g. an arcane sigil pointer, to enhance the gaming feel.
